description: issue #682 (slice I3), the boundary the two-halves requirement protects: WITHOUT the `interaction-events` profile, `when` is not a visible name, so the semantic checker's `unknownCommandRule` rejects it with `ol-unknown-command` (spec/error-model.md's `ol-unknown-command`). This proves the `when` visible-name registration is correctly gated behind the profile — a Core-only program cannot use `when` — and that C2 (#664)'s checker gate is live: parsing a profile form is not enough, the name must also be registered under an active profile. `interaction-events` is NOT in `SUPPORTED_PROFILES` (terminal slice #688 claims it), but a fixture may still request it for `check()` name visibility.
